name: whoami
description: Return the authenticated user's id, email, role (user or admin), and admin status.

name: search_users
description: Search registered accounts by email or display name (admin only). Returns up to 50 accounts with id, email, display_name, role and created_at. Empty query lists accounts; use offset increments of 50 to paginate. Civic people records are separate from login accounts.

name: promote_user_to_admin
description: Promote an existing registered user to admin (admin only). Grants content editing, private-content access and permission to promote other users immediately. Resolve the exact account with search_users and act only on an explicit request to promote that person. Cannot promote yourself, create an account or demote an admin. Repeating a promotion of another existing admin is harmless.

name: search_site
description: Search civic types or structured official-source county data. type=county_statistic returns numeric observations with units, periods, provenance and uncertainty; type=county_statistic_catalog discovers the statistics catalog. mode=site (default) returns ranked site rows, includes past events, and supports limit/offset. mode=directory requires organization/person/map/election/event and returns the original directory rows/order; event filters require directory event mode. Directory mode has no offset. Visibility follows your account.

name: get_civic_record
description: Get one civic record by type and UUID through its existing visibility gate. Preserves person affiliations, election contests/key dates, event calendar/organization and map layers/effective styles. Other types retain their original record envelope; article association sets remain admin-only. Related lists and geometry have separate tools.

name: get_county_statistic_catalog
description: Discover structured Georgia county civic and demographic statistics. Returns all counties/FIPS/slugs, topics, indicators (units, definitions, headline positions), and official source datasets with URLs, retrieval dates and SHA-256 checksums. Start here before search_county_statistics; 13000 is the Georgia state comparison. Current profile has 59 measures per geography. More official sources/measures can be added by admins.

name: search_county_statistics
description: Search official-source county civic/demographic data by county name/FIPS, measure, topic, publisher, reference period or query text. Filter with county_fips, indicator_code or topic. Returns numeric values, units, availability, Georgia/county identity, periods, source URLs/checksums, numerator/denominator, ACS margins and SAIPE confidence intervals. Empty query browses; paginate until total_count is covered. Values are source-specific estimates, not personalized data. For Georgia comparisons query county_fips=13000 using the same indicator. Static downloads: /counties/<slug>/statistics.csv and statistics.json; live REST: county_statistic_records.

name: save_county_statistic
description: Create or update a structured official-source county statistic (admin only). Resolve county, indicator and source from get_county_statistic_catalog first. Supply exact existing updated_at to update; null creates only and never overwrites. Preserve period, provenance, uncertainty and calculation inputs. Explicit unavailable/suppressed status requires null value; do not substitute zero or guess missing data. Updates mark the static website for rebuild; REST/MCP reads change immediately.

name: save_county_statistic_source
description: Create/update an official-source dataset catalog entry (admin only). Verify the original official source and exact file SHA-256 before saving. This metadata is returned by public API/MCP and static exports. Existing statistic rows retain their values; refresh them separately. Changes trigger a website rebuild.

name: delete_organization
description: Delete an organization (admin only).

name: delete_calendar
description: Delete a calendar (admin only).

name: delete_event
description: Delete a calendar event (admin only).

name: delete_person
description: Delete a person (admin only).

name: delete_election
description: Delete an election (admin only).

name: manage_election_results
description: Structured Georgia SOS JSON: import_turnout accepts sanitized schema-v1 document text plus exact UTF-8 SHA-256, maximum 2 MiB / 795 rows in one atomic transaction, dry_run defaults true; read_turnout returns paged typed measures, provenance and history. Preserve unavailable values, source as-of separately from capture, county FIPS, original styles and all absentee measures. Election Day In-Person/election_day is accepted only as source-reported turnout rows in QDFdpV; never infer it from totals. Never add overlapping views. JSON evidence is immutable in Postgres; no image upload is needed. Admin election result workflow: upload original JPEG/PNG/PDF base64 (10 MiB, SHA-256 dedup), view a private original, read paginated scoped snapshots/history, or import a complete cumulative report (dry_run=true by default). The agent performs OCR; uploading does not extract votes. Resolve printed election date, tabulator/precinct, ballot style and candidate/question UUIDs. Same scope+timestamp+snapshot is a no-op even for different photos; conflicting OCR rejects. Newer reports require expected_report_id and retain history. Never add county summaries to tapes or successive reports. Unknown metrics stay null; unreadable choices block saving. Printed total_votes excludes separately printed unresolved write-ins. Preserve election versus contest turnout denominators. Certification requires explicit support, not tape boilerplate. Future elections accept turnout only. Sources retain private crop/page locators and transcription. Empty reports means not reported, not zero.

unit.description: Canonical precinct code or tabulator ID; county reports use all. Never invent an ID for a cropped tape.

ballot_style.description: Use all for combined ballots; preserve primary party/ballot style when separate.

name: school_finances
description: Bibb school payroll/payment records. operation.action=browse reads published releases with dataset/year/query/person filters, sort and pagination; source rows are not headcounts or invoices. Never add overlapping payroll and payment totals. All other actions require admin: begin registers the schema-v1 manifest; append accepts 1–500 immutable rows / 1 MiB with exact decimal strings and source row numbers; publish requires confirm_publication=true and expected_current_id (null initially), complete count and exact totals. It atomically replaces the current release. During staging, resolve_payroll_person links a supported existing person using release_id, row_number, person_id, confirm_identity=true and a sourced review_note. Preserve ambiguity: unresolved payroll rows receive separate public person stubs flagged for review; names alone do not prove identity. review_person requires release_id, row_number, person_id, confirm_identity=true and sourced review_note; never merges people. Payment publication reuses a unique exact person/organization name match, otherwise creates a provisional organization stub marked for review. resolve_recipient takes recipient_id, kind (person/organization), optional target_id (omit to create a stub) and a sourced review_note; aggregate SALARY/SALARIES/BENEFITS rows have no payee profile. withdraw hides the release and its generated profiles without reviving history. Retain original files in collector evidence. See docs/school-finances.md for precise contracts.

name: accept_user_fee_report
description: Admin version-1 fee report acceptance, default dry run, atomic 1–100 observations/1 MiB. Stable report/fee/row source identities, original labels, reviewed existing org UUID for public reports (unresolved raw org labels stay unlinked/private), source URL/SHA/retrieval/publication/locator/coverage required. Rates are structured scalar/range/tiered/text/unknown with decimal strings and explicit units; collections separate string/null. Authority is not current effectiveness. Exact replay unchanged; amendments explicitly name latest supersedes_id and correction_reason. No collectors/stubs or inferred transactions. See docs/user-fees.md.

name: browse_user_fees
description: Read source-backed fee schedules and separate collections; filter organization/year/fee/query/history and paginate. Public projections exclude restricted report chains for ordinary sign-in. Missing collections are unknown, not zero; never divide collections by rates to estimate transactions.

name: accept_obligation_report
description: Admin version-1 complete bounded obligation report acceptance, default dry run; 1–100 rows/1 MiB atomic. Preserve raw payer/vendor labels, source grain, signed decimal strings, currency/unit/period and full provenance. Reviewed existing person/org vendors only; unresolved vendors private/unlinked. No payments/contract/balance inference or automatic stubs. Exact retry unchanged; corrections/cancellations append explicit latest supersession with reason. See docs/obligations.md.

name: browse_obligations
description: Read/search/detail source obligations, not payments. Optional organization/year/vendor/query/observation/history filters; bounded pages. Hidden-person rows are excluded entirely from public counts, raw names, links and sums. Exact visible sums only per source-asserted disjoint report revision/currency/unit/period/grain; never combine report groups/history or infer balances.

name: get_layer_geojson
description: Get stored layer geometry. Non-admin callers must provide a visible map containing this layer.

name: delete_map
description: Delete a map and its layer links, preserving reusable layers (admin only).

name: delete_layer
description: Delete a reusable layer, its stored features and all map links (admin only).

name: save_postgis_layer
description: Create or update a stored PostGIS layer atomically (admin only). Creation requires name and a GeoJSON FeatureCollection. Use id to update; omitted metadata is preserved. Omit geojson on update to keep features; otherwise the entire dataset is replaced. Limit: 10 MB / 10,000 features.

name: delete_contest
description: Delete a contest and its candidacy links, preserving people (admin only).

name: delete_ballot_question
description: Delete a ballot question (admin only).

name: delete_article
description: Delete an article and its association links, preserving people/organizations (admin only).

name: search_layer_features
description: Search or browse stored feature properties with pagination. IDs are bigint strings. Non-admins must supply a visible map containing the layer.

name: get_layer_feature
description: Get one stored feature by its internal bigint-string id. Non-admins must provide a visible containing map.

name: delete_layer_feature
description: Delete one stored feature (admin only).

name: get_my_profile
description: Get your own account profile.

name: update_my_profile
description: Update your own display name (admin only). This does not grant admin access or edit another user.

name: list_images
description: Browse/search public organization logos or person images, with pagination.

name: get_image_url
description: Get the public URL for an organization logo or person image.

name: upload_image
description: Upload a user-supplied PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG image (admin only, max 2 MB). Base64 must omit any data-URL prefix. Set overwrite only when replacing an existing image; use the returned path in logo_path or image_path.

name: delete_image
description: Remove an organization logo or person image object (admin only). Update any record referencing its path separately.

name: import_meeting_source
description: Admin compact or checked-attachment import/reconciliation. Default dry run. Adapter simbli-minutes-v1 reads captured public agenda/minutes JSON text, both Voting and VotingHTML. Supply exact source-name→existing person UUID bindings, never fuzzy guesses. Attachment bytes are downloaded with caller auth and SHA-256 checked. No arbitrary URL fetch. Compact payload shares provenance once and nests named ballots; at most 2000 expanded attendance/motion/ballot rows and 2 MiB of PostgreSQL JSONB text. A 150-observation fixture fits one call. Rows are ordered partial observations in one transaction, NOT all-or-nothing: unchanged inline retry is a no-op, conflicts/errors are reported without immutable overwrite. Reconcile existing sources before import; do not invent new keys to bypass conflicts. A checked-attachment import into a meeting with vote sources under the same provider requires bindings for every document motion locator, including identical retries; legacy ballot keys also need explicit bindings when different from generated keys. Inline reconcile_only returns an inventory, not a comparison verdict. Does not infer outcomes or attendance from roster/totals. No automatic publication; rebuild public pages.

name: import_meeting_records
description: Validate or atomically import up to 100 sourced attendance, motion rounds and individual choices (2 MiB, admin only). Default dry_run=true. Resolve existing meeting/person UUIDs; order attendance then votes then choices. Each provider/source_key is immutable: exact replay returns canonical IDs unchanged; changed snapshots or editorial drift reject the entire batch. Omission never deletes. Use observed for presence supported only at a ballot, unknown for roster-only evidence, and choice unknown for Vote Not Recorded. Never infer ballots or outcomes from totals, unanimity or sponsorship. Preserve agenda context separately from actual motion text. See get_meeting for reconciliation.

name: set_meeting_vote_outcome
description: Append a cited outcome observation to an existing meeting vote (admin only). Required source_url/document_sha256/locator must support the exact motion; never infer from totals or passFail codes. Exact replay is unchanged. Conflicts do not overwrite. To correct, read get_meeting, pass its latest observation ID as supersedes_id and a public correction_reason. Original imported rows and citations remain unchanged. Public static pages require rebuild.

name: get_person_meeting_votes
description: Read paginated meeting ballots with original source evidence, optional organization and inclusive date filters. Public meetings only for non-admins, including ordinary signed-in users; private/unlisted meetings require admin discovery access. Unknown means no supported recorded choice. Public slug profiles show imports after rebuild; signed-in/UUID profiles read live.

name: begin_meeting_attachment_upload
description: Begin/reconcile an original-document upload (admin, 1–26,214,400 bytes). Stable provider/source_key returns the same 24-hour session; changed metadata conflicts. Connected agents use manage_meeting_attachment_upload action=transfer_chunk with id, byte offset and at most 256 KiB of original bytes encoded as base64; transfer_status reconciles progress without exposing the caller token or TUS Location. Legacy direct-TUS endpoint/scoped x-signature metadata is also returned for applications that already possess their own user token; connected agents must not extract one. Never send a whole large file in one MCP call. Never set x-upsert. Finalize after upload; status reconciles uncertain responses. PDF, Office, OpenDocument, TXT, CSV and JSON projections supported. Signed token expires in 2 hours; repeat begin to refresh within session lifetime. No R2 publication.

name: finalize_meeting_attachment_upload
description: Verify uploaded original size, type signature and SHA-256, then atomically create one canonical meeting attachment (admin). Retry safely after timeout using the same session UUID; completed sessions return the same attachment. Missing, expired or cancelled originals are rejected. No public-archive publication.

name: manage_meeting_attachment_upload
description: Admin upload transfer/reconciliation/cleanup. action=transfer_chunk accepts id, exact byte offset and data_base64 of 1–262144 original bytes (maximum 349528 base64 characters). Server forwards caller auth internally and owns HEAD/TUS state; never supply an OAuth token or arbitrary URL. Exact replay is unchanged; changed chunk bytes conflict. transfer_status returns committed/storage offsets and pending-chunk bounds; retry the exact pending chunk after uncertainty. A lost creation Location returns creation_uncertain without another POST; operator reconciliation is required. Confirmed pre-creation JWT expiry returns authentication_required only if its durable intent is safely cleared; refresh the connection and retry the same session. Transfer is bound to its initiating admin. action=status retains session/checksum/stored-object metadata. action=cancel records a durable cancelled receipt and removes any completed staged object; it does not terminate partial TUS resources or revoke issued capabilities. Private partial bytes expire in Storage, and in-flight writes may require repeated cleanup after capabilities expire. Completed attachments are protected. action=list_cleanup lists up to 100 expired/cancelled receipts. No existing backfill attachments are deleted automatically.

name: get_meeting
description: Get a meeting’s notes, transcript, attendance, votes and attachment metadata through its event/calendar visibility gate. Use this before uploading to avoid duplicates.

name: upload_meeting_attachment
description: Upload a document to an existing meeting (admin only, maximum 3 MiB via inline base64; use begin_meeting_attachment_upload for larger originals up to 25 MiB). Set is_meeting=true with create_event/update_event first. Supply file_name and base64 bytes without a data-URL prefix. PDF, Office, OpenDocument, TXT and CSV are supported. The file inherits meeting visibility; no public bucket is used. Uploads create new attachments: after an uncertain result, inspect get_meeting before retrying.

name: get_meeting_attachment_url
description: Get a 60-second download URL for an attachment of a permitted meeting. Requires both meeting_id and attachment_id; visibility is checked before signing. Never persist the expiring URL as a source link.

name: get_georgia_legislative_source
description: Read official Georgia General Assembly sessions, chamber rosters, vote lists or vote details with provenance and pagination. Use numeric official member IDs to reconcile an existing person and dated office term before import_legislation. isRollCall denotes attendance, not a legislative vote. This read-only tool never imports or guesses identities, outcomes or missing choices.

name: browse_legislation
description: Browse legislative terms, sessions, bills, sponsorships, actions, votes and media links. Visibility is enforced for every referenced object. Use id for a known unlisted record; bill_id/person_id provide direct unlisted context. Results include total and bounded rows with reference labels.

name: get_legislative_vote_totals
description: Compare visible member choices against official reported totals; null comparison means incomplete coverage or unspecified totals.

name: get_person_legislative_record
description: Get historical member vote choices linked to the office held at the time. Missing choices are unknown, never inferred absences. Procedural choices are not endorsements.

name: import_legislation
description: Import up to 1,000 normalized legislative records in ordered, atomic batches of at most 100 (admin only). Each batch commits separately. On a failed batch, returns partial status and next_offset for an idempotent retry; later batches are not attempted. Parents must precede children. Preserve original source IDs, choices and provenance; never guess identities. Default mode=atomic preserves the original single-batch transaction and response (at most 100 rows). Explicit mode=batched enables resumable multi-batch imports. Preserve reviewed attendance classifications.

name: describe_legislative_resource
description: Get fields, allowed choices, required values and foreign-key targets for a legislative resource before editing or importing.

name: save_legislative_record
description: Create or patch a legislative record (admin only). First use describe_legislative_resource. Supply id to patch an existing row; omit it to create. Context cannot be reassigned. For repeatable imports use import_legislation with provider IDs.

name: delete_legislative_record
description: Delete a legislative record (admin only). Referenced records must be reconciled first; audit history remains.

name: list_offices
description: Find existing public offices before creating a seat. Filter by organization or exact office UUID; paginate with offset.

name: read_officeholder_observations
description: Read bounded dated roster observations for an existing person or organization. Snapshots do not establish term boundaries or current officeholders. Optional exact day/year context and supersession history; same public-only visibility for ordinary signed-in users.

name: accept_officeholder_observations
description: Admin version-1 dated roster evidence acceptance, default dry run; up to 100 immutable rows / 1 MiB atomically. Preserve reported labels; exact reviewed UUID reconciliation, day/year/unknown precision and source URL/SHA/retrieval/locator required. No fuzzy matching or people/term creation. Changed stable identities require latest supersedes_id and correction_reason; no overwrite. See docs/backend.md for row contract.

name: get_public_document
description: Get a published public document and its public meeting links. Admins can also inspect pending/withdrawn publication metadata.

name: list_public_documents
description: Browse or search published document titles and file names. This does not search file contents. include_unpublished requires admin access.

name: link_public_document_meeting
description: Link an already published document to another public, listed meeting without uploading another copy (admin only). Useful for a combined committee/full-board transcript.

name: search_document_contents
description: Search published document contents using Cloudflare hybrid search. Returns matching passages and document/meeting citations; automated transcripts and OCR can contain errors.

name: publish_meeting_document
description: Explicitly publish a public meeting attachment to the unrestricted public document archive (admin only). This creates an independently public copy; changing meeting visibility does not withdraw it. Never use for private research or confidential files. Publication must be enabled by the operator. Inspect the catalog after an uncertain response before retrying.

name: withdraw_public_document
description: Withdraw a published document from the catalog and delete its public R2 object (admin only). Affects all linked meetings. Search passages are blocked immediately; index cleanup follows R2 sync. Public downloads already copied elsewhere cannot be recalled. Pending publications must be resolved first.

name: save_organization
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create an organization (admin only). Update: Update an organization (admin only).

name: save_calendar
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a calendar (admin only). Update: Update a calendar (admin only).

name: save_event
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a calendar event (admin only). Set is_meeting=true to add a video URL, notes, a transcript or document attachments. Update: Update a calendar event (admin only). Set is_meeting=true to enable a video URL, meeting records and document attachments. Omitted fields are preserved.

meeting_video_start_seconds.description: Optional recording start offset in whole seconds. Overrides URL timestamps. Null uses the URL/default start; zero starts at the beginning. Separate meetings can share a video URL with different offsets.

meeting_video_url.description: Recording URL. YouTube/Vimeo show an embedded player; other hosts show a link. Separate meetings may share the same recording. Use null to clear.

meeting_video_start_seconds.description: Optional recording start offset in whole seconds. Overrides URL timestamps. Null uses the URL/default start; zero starts at the beginning. Separate meetings can share a video URL with different offsets.

meeting_video_url.description: Recording URL. YouTube/Vimeo show an embedded player; other hosts show a link. Separate meetings may share the same recording. Use null to clear.

name: save_person
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a person (admin only). Update: Update a person (admin only).

name: save_election
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create an election (admin only). Update: Update an election (admin only).

name: save_map
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a map (admin only). Add reusable layers using save_relationship. Update: Partially update a map (admin only). Layer links are managed separately.

name: save_layer
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a remote GeoJSON URL layer (admin only). Use save_postgis_layer for stored geometry. Update: Partially update layer metadata (admin only). This does not replace stored geometry or change its source type.

name: save_contest
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create an office contest within an election (admin only). Update: Partially update an election contest (admin only).

name: save_ballot_question
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a referendum/amendment/ballot question (admin only). Defaults to Yes/No choices. Update: Partially update a ballot question (admin only).

name: save_article
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create an article and optional person/organization links atomically (admin only). Omit unknown dates; never infer publication dates from fetched dates. Update: Partially update an article atomically (admin only). Omitted fields and association sets are preserved; null clears a date and [] clears that link set.

name: save_layer_feature
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a stored-layer feature atomically (admin only). Geometry must be WGS84 longitude/latitude. Position defaults to the next available position. Update: Partially update a stored feature without replacing the dataset (admin only). null clears the source feature_id; internal id remains unchanged.

name: save_office
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Create a durable office or seat (admin only). Resolve an existing organization and list_offices first to avoid duplicates. Update: Partially update an office (admin only). Omitted fields are preserved.

name: save_office_term
description: Use request.operation=create or update; updates preserve omissions and never upsert. Delete separately. Create: Record one period of actual office service (admin only). Read read_related_records (relation=office_terms) first. Separate reelected terms when boundaries are documented; use election/contest/candidacy tools for election dates. Database validates date order, precision bounds and duplicate starts. Update: Partially correct a service record (admin only). Omitted fields are preserved; null ends_on records ongoing service. Database validates date order and precision bounds. Preserve historical service and its source.

ends_on.description: Inclusive last day of actual service; null means ongoing. Do not forecast a departure.

starts_on_precision.description: For year precision, store January 1 solely as a sorting bound.

ends_on_precision.description: For a concluded year-only term, store December 31 solely as a sorting bound.

ends_on.description: Inclusive last day of actual service; null means ongoing. Do not forecast a departure.

starts_on_precision.description: For year precision, store January 1 solely as a sorting bound.

ends_on_precision.description: For a concluded year-only term, store December 31 solely as a sorting bound.

name: save_relationship
description: Create or partially update one relationship (admin only). Select request.relationship and change.operation=create or update. Composite links require both endpoint IDs and update attributes only. Organization and person relationships use a row UUID for updates; endpoints, labels and source may be edited. Omitted fields are preserved; update never upserts. Delete separately. Link two different organizations (admin only). relationship labels the related organization on the first profile; reverse_relationship labels the first on the related profile. One row appears on both profiles; reverse duplicate pairs are rejected.

name: delete_relationship
description: Delete only one relationship (admin only); preserve people, organizations, articles, contests, maps and layers. Select request.relationship. Composite links require both endpoint IDs; organization_relationship and person_relationship require its row UUID and removes the link from both endpoint profiles. Use save_relationship for create/update.

name: read_related_records
description: Read related civic records using request.relation and its original UUID keys. Responses retain their original arrays or status envelopes, ordering and fields. map_layers returns visible styled layers; map_layer_links, article_people and article_organizations are admin-only editable links. Other reads use existing person/election/contest/organization visibility gates. contest_candidate requires contest_id and person_id; office_terms requires person_id or organization_id (both allowed). calendars accepts an optional organization_id. No arbitrary joins, account records, geometry, implicit pagination or broadened discovery.

oneOf.description: Get visible layers in stacking order, including effective per-map styles.
Get a person’s permitted article reading list, with publication dates and relationship labels.
Get an organization’s permitted article reading list.
Get a person’s visible current and past election candidacies.
Get organization affiliations through the person visibility gate.
List an election’s contests through its visibility gate.
List an election’s ballot questions through its visibility gate.
List the candidates of a visible contest, including party, status and certified write-in flag.
Get one person’s candidacy through the contest/election visibility gate.
Get editable positions and style overrides for map-layer links (admin only).
List related organizations, with labels normalized for the requested profile and source URLs.
List related people visible at both endpoints, with directional labels and source URLs. Anonymous reads require both people public; signed-in reads follow person viewer access.
List editable article association links (admin only). Profile reading lists remain available to other users.
List editable article association links (admin only). Profile reading lists remain available to other users.
List calendars the caller can see, optionally for one organization.
Get dated actual service through the person/organization visibility gate. Provide person_id or organization_id. Election victories do not automatically create service records.
